messages:
harper: Following the postmortem, we need a compact set of owners for rollout backstops: panic/pause API, auto-rollback rules, and rollout telemetry. Short deadlines pls.
dong: Agree. I can take auto-rollback. Proposal: require 2 independent signals out of error_rate, p95_latency, and saturation to trigger. Configurable sustained window. ETA: 9 working days for prototype.
zainab: I'll own telemetry + dashboards. Plan: emit 'rollout_fraction', 'flag_error_rate_5m', and 'flag_p95_10m' as tags per-flag. Add 1h histogram retention and a dashboard template. ETA: 5 days.
luca: Ops will build the panic/pause endpoint + runbook. UI button should flip traffic to 0% and post an incident-thread to #incidents automatically. Prototype mock this week.
ops-bot: incident-bot: linked postmortem 1023 -> https://redwood/postmortems/1023. Please attach follow-ups.
ci-bot: reminder: include a CI behavioral test that simulates a spike and verifies auto-rollback and notification.
dong: Draft config example for the runtime (will include in design doc):
```
rollout_policy:
  max_fraction: 0.05
  safety_window_seconds: 1800
  auto_rollback:
    require_signals: 2
    signals:
      - error_rate_5m > 0.04
      - p95_latency_10m > 1500
    sustained_seconds: 180
```
harper: Nice. Action items I'll add to the postmortem tracker: auto-rollback design + prototype (dong) 9d, telemetry + dashboard (zainab) 5d, panic endpoint + runbook (luca) 4d, CI behavioral tests (team) 10d. Also adding recurring quarterly audit for rollout incidents.
zainab: I'll also add two alert levels: warning at 50% of thresholds and critical at threshold. Route to #eng-oncall + PagerDuty.
dong: Will include unit + integration tests and a small traffic simulator. Need product/SLO owners to sign off on defaults before we bake them. CC @product @slo.
luca: Runbook sketch: 1) confirm alert 2) check dashboard/telemetry 3) if auto-rollback fired, validate downstream, then approve re-release. Panic button steps: flip to 0%, notify pager, create incident doc.
harper: Please update the postmortem with PR links when ready. We'll review in the next ops sync. If any owner needs to shift timelines, comment on the tracker. Thanks all.
